The '''Mission to Kuratooine''' took place in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to apprehend the corrupt Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
